name: chill-to-the-bone-two-phantasia-debuff
notes: Branch B (2+ phantasias controlled by the caster), now exercising the card's actual primary use case: the DEFENDING player (player 2) casts Chill to the Bone on the ATTACKING player's (player 1's) attacking ally, mid-combat. Same shape and same fixed engine bug as chill-to-the-bone-low-phantasia-debuff (see its meta.json for the full writeup of ChillToTheBoneResolve's fixed GetZoneObject/ConvertMzToPlayerPerspective perspective handling in GameLogic.php). Player 2 (the defender/caster) additionally controls two Core Fractal (8hqHAU0Xj6, TOKEN,PHANTASIA) cards on their own field -- Core Fractal specifically rather than a more thematic phantasia because it has no dispatch entries of its own that could desync the scripted action sequence. ChillToTheBoneResolve counts ZoneSearch('myField', ['PHANTASIA']) = 2 on the CASTER's (player 2's) own field -- not the attacker's -- and tags the attacker with 'p00ghqhcpb-4' instead of '-2', consumed by the same POWER/LIFE switch statements as the sibling fixture. This also proves the phantasia count is read relative to the caster, independent of the perspective-conversion fix applied to the CombatAttacker lookup. Dungeon Guide's printed POWER 1 / LIFE 3 becomes -3 / -1 after the -4/-4 debuff.

rulesClauses: If you control two or more phantasias, that ally gets -4 POWER and -4 LIFE instead.

Perspective-correctness: the effect resolves correctly when cast by the DEFENDING player (a different player than the attacker), and the phantasia count is read from the caster's (not the attacker's) field.
